hops.query: foreign currency exchange rate impact on net revenues and operating income
hops.rationale: The KO 2025 filing (FY2024 data, Item 7) directly answers the goal. Passage 66 states the total FX impact on net operating revenues was a 5% decrease in 2024 and 4% in 2023, and on operating income an 11% decrease in 2024 and 8% in 2023, including hedging. It also describes how FX gains and losses are recorded. Passages 40 and 41 give segment-level FX impacts on operating income (e.g., Europe, Middle East & Africa -15%, Latin America -17%, Asia Pacific -2%, Global Ventures +1%, Bottling Investments -1%). Passage 34 adds a full-year 2025 outlook that FX will unfavorably affect net operating revenues. Together these cover both requested elements, net revenues and operating income, within the KO Item 7 scope. Passage 35 is supporting context only.
